all_responses.definition: Coverage over all evaluated responses. Plan-scoped score averages impute missing, non-plan, or inapplicable turn scores as 0 over all evaluated turns, so this group reflects end-to-end response coverage. Score counts report observed non-null scores; score denominators report the averaging denominator.

successful_plans.definition: Conditional average over turns where the benchmark expected a plan and the model delivered a parseable plan. Missing or inapplicable scores are not imputed as 0.

definitions.response_mode_accuracy: Whether each turn uses the expected response mode: plan, clarification, or no-solution.
definitions.fulfillment_score: Whether the current turn's requested update or response requirement is handled correctly.
definitions.preserve_score: Whether historical hard constraints listed in must_preserve remain satisfied.
definitions.plan_feasibility: Feasibility averaged only over turns where a plan is expected and a plan is delivered.
definitions.cumulative_requirement_satisfaction: Active hard constraints plus active soft preferences, averaged only over delivered expected-plan turns.
definitions.hard_all_pass_rate: Share of expected-plan turns where a delivered plan satisfies every active hard constraint; missing or non-plan responses count as failures.
definitions.hard_all_pass_rate_filtered: Reference metric: share of delivered expected-plan turns where every active hard constraint passes.
definitions.end_to_end_requirement_strict: Strict requirement score over all expected-plan turns. Missing/non-plan responses score 0; delivered plans average hard_all_pass and active soft-preference score.
definitions.preserve_error_count: Failed preserved historical hard constraints. Active soft preferences are included in cumulative_requirement_satisfaction.
